subject: Error message in rsf.fit Error in beta != beta.init : comparison of these types is not implemented

messages.author: c34aef386fa2d9d3
messages.subject: Error message in rsf.fit Error in beta != beta.init : comparison of these types is not implemented
parts:
Hi Chris,

I am currently trying to run the weighted RSFs mentioned in Alston et al. (2022), 
however I am getting this error: 

Error in beta != beta.init : comparison of these types is not implemented.

My code is 
Goshawk_563_rsf <- ctmm::rsf.fit(Goshawk_563_T ,  Goshawk_563_wAKDE, list(TC= Tree_Cover), which follows the requirements as stated in the R Documentation, where Goshawk_563_T is a telemetry object and Goshawk_563_wAKDE is a UD created with the akde function. 

May I know if you have any ideas on how to correct this error? Thank you!
